concerns.text: Batch correction with Harmony is applied before developmental windows are defined. This may remove or attenuate true age‑related transcriptional signals, confounding the downstream rewiring analysis. The methodology should either perform windowing first or explicitly test that age gradients are preserved after correction.

A minimum of 10 cells per window is enforced (FR‑011). GRNBoost2 typically requires hundreds of cells for stable TF‑target importance scores; windows with only ~10–20 cells will yield unreliable networks, threatening construct validity of rewiring events.

The power claim references a vague identifier ("methodology‑32aa8ec6") without describing the simulation parameters, effect size assumptions, or variance estimates. This insufficient justification cannot support the stated >80 % power to detect enrichment.

Replication is conditional on the availability of an open scRNA‑seq cohort. If such data are not found, the project will lack the mandated independent validation (Principle VII), leaving the core claim unverified.
